n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

def sum_mod(x, y):
    s = x + y
    if s >= mod:
        s -= mod
    return s

def product_mod(x, y):
    return (x * y) % mod

maxn = 505
C = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
f = [0] * maxn
g = [0] * maxn
F = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
G = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

# Compute binomial coefficients
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = sum_mod(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j])

# Compute f and g arrays
f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        val1 = product_mod(product_mod(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), product_mod(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]))
        f[i] = sum_mod(f[i], val1)
        val2 = product_mod(product_mod(f[j - 1], g[i - j]), product_mod(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]))
        g[i] = sum_mod(g[i], val2)
        val3 = product_mod(product_mod(g[j - 1], f[i - j]), product_mod(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]))
        g[i] = sum_mod(g[i], val3)
        val4 = product_mod(product_mod(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), product_mod(sum_mod(C[j][2], C[i - j + 1][2]), C[i - 1][j - 1]))
        g[i] = sum_mod(g[i], val4)

# Initialize F and G
F[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    F[i][i] = f[i]
    G[i][i] = g[i]
    for j in range(0, min(i, m + 1)):
        for l in range(0, j + 1):
            G[i][j] = sum_mod(G[i][j], product_mod(product_mod(g[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]))
            F[i][j] = sum_mod(F[i][j], product_mod(product_mod(f[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]))
            G[i][j] = sum_mod(G[i][j], product_mod(product_mod(f[l], G[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]))

print(G[n][m])
</translated_code>
